entities.summary: Cyprus, a notable figure in the history of Türkiye, associated with Multi-Party Era and Military Interventions (1960–1983). Preceded by Turkey joins NATO and 1960 military coup — PM Adnan Menderes overthrown and later executed. Their legacy influenced Turkey invades Cyprus — Operation Attila divides the island and 1980 military coup — the most comprehensive intervention in Turkish history.
